_doc: Hand-maintained nutrient source data. scripts/build-nutrients.ts expands dri_bands against age_bands into data/nutrients.json. Values follow the Food and Nutrition Board DRI tables as reproduced on each nutrient's NIH ODS health-professional fact sheet (source_url). A null in a band array means no value is established for that band. 'both' applies one array to male and female. Ages are whole years; infants (<1 year) are out of scope in v1.

nutrients.name: Vitamin A

unit_conversions.note: mcg of preformed vitamin A equals mcg RAE

nutrients.ul_note: The UL applies to preformed vitamin A (retinol and retinyl esters) only, not to beta-carotene or other carotenoids.

nutrients.name: Vitamin C
nutrients.ul_note: Smokers need 35 mg/day more than the RDA shown.

nutrients.name: Vitamin E
nutrients.ul_note: The UL applies to any form of supplemental alpha-tocopherol.

nutrients.name: Other Tocopherols and Tocotrienols
nutrients.ul_note: Non-alpha tocopherols and tocotrienols do not count toward vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) requirements or its UL. Totaled for overlap detection only.

nutrients.name: Vitamin K
nutrients.ul_note: No UL has been established. Vitamin K can interact with warfarin; interactions are not assessed by this service.

nutrients.name: Thiamin
nutrients.ul_note: No UL has been established.

nutrients.name: Riboflavin
nutrients.ul_note: No UL has been established.

nutrients.name: Niacin
nutrients.ul_note: RDA is in mg niacin equivalents (NE); supplement niacin is counted as mg niacin. The UL applies to niacin from supplements and fortified foods.

nutrients.name: Folate

unit_conversions.note: 1 mcg folic acid from a supplement = 1.7 mcg DFE

nutrients.ul_note: The UL is in mcg of folic acid and applies to folic acid from supplements and fortified foods, not to food folate or other supplemental forms. Folic acid mcg = mcg DFE / 1.7.

nutrients.name: Vitamin B12
nutrients.ul_note: No UL has been established.

nutrients.name: Biotin
nutrients.ul_note: No UL has been established. High-dose biotin can interfere with some laboratory tests.

nutrients.name: Pantothenic Acid
nutrients.ul_note: No UL has been established.

nutrients.name: Chromium
nutrients.ul_note: No UL has been established.

nutrients.name: Magnesium
nutrients.ul_note: The UL applies to magnesium from supplements and medications only, not to magnesium naturally present in food and water.

nutrients.name: Potassium
nutrients.ul_note: No UL has been established (2019 DRI report).

nutrients.name: Boron
nutrients.ul_note: No RDA or AI has been established; only a UL.

nutrients.name: Beta-Carotene
nutrients.ul_note: Listed separately when a label declares beta-carotene as its own row rather than as a form of vitamin A. Not converted to vitamin A RAE.

nutrients.name: EPA (Eicosapentaenoic Acid)
nutrients.ul_note: No DRI or UL. FDA considers up to 5 g/day of combined EPA and DHA from supplements acceptable; this is not a DRI and is not used for flags.

nutrients.name: DHA (Docosahexaenoic Acid)
nutrients.ul_note: No DRI or UL. FDA considers up to 5 g/day of combined EPA and DHA from supplements acceptable; this is not a DRI and is not used for flags.

nutrients.name: Melatonin
nutrients.ul_note: Not a nutrient; no DRI or UL. Totaled for overlap detection only.

nutrients.name: Coenzyme Q10
nutrients.ul_note: Not a nutrient; no DRI or UL. Totaled for overlap detection only.

label_dv_source: FDA Daily Values for adults and children 4 years and older, 21 CFR 101.9(c)(8)(iv) and 101.36 (2016 Nutrition and Supplement Facts rule). Used only to read a label amount whose unit DSLD omits or gives without its basis, and only when the label %DV matches.
